notes: One independent generation per colour/value pair; separate shared back. No generated text. Frames, values, colour labels and monochrome variants are added deterministically by scripts/painted-artwork.mjs. JPEG encoding is resized to 1400px maximum edge at quality 78 for printing and downloads; original PNGs remain in the generation tool's output directory.
